violations.text: The establishment is using a special process of jarring (Berry Jam & Vanilla Pear Jam) without approval from a process authority and RIDOH CFP. Jams were placed under embargo at time of inspection. The establishment must get all recipes approved from a process authority and obtain approval from the RIDOH-Center for Food Protection prior to selling. New Violation. Correct By: 08/11/2026

Cream cheese was observed expired in the refrigerator. Food must be used within 7 days. Cream cheese was voluntarily disposed of (see attached disposal form). Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/25/2024

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per interview of person in charge, deli meats were placed warm in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/25/2024

The sink used for food preparation is lacking an air gap. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/01/2024
The condensate from the walk-in cooler is draining into a container. Condensate drainage and other nonsewage liquids must drain into a drain. New Violation. Correct By: 08/01/2024
